title: Power Rankings: New-look Pistons, Nuggets gaining ground
heading: 2008-09 Power Rankings: Week 3
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: I hear folks chirping about Boston's recent lackluster starts and thinking they've found vulnerability. Fine. We prefer to focus on the strong finishes that netted a 7-1 record during a sapping span of eight games in 12 days.
